subject: tap running while brushing
title: What If You Left the Tap Running While Brushing?

scenes.text: What if you always left the tap running while brushing? It feels like nothing. It isn't.
An older bathroom faucet pours about 2 gallons a minute, so a two-minute brush drains roughly 4 gallons.
Brush twice a day, and the US EPA says turning off the tap could save up to 8 gallons daily.
Over a year, that's roughly 2,900 gallons, from one sink and one person.
The average American uses about 82 gallons a day at home, so that's over a month of water.
Newer faucets flow at about half that rate. But the fastest upgrade is still a flick of your wrist.
